notes.title: Update v.0.8.11
notes.content:
Hello players

I apologize for the delay of the update. I said it would be out last month, but I've been busy with bugs and other development related events. 


- Updated ground textures for the Dune planet

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470738/d2113929384d20943e01337a24761064fe5e4163.png

- Updated ground textures for the Frostfall planet

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470738/461bc2ce665b66621a60c6eeb259bd2a50a36142.png

- Improved texture quality of environmental objects across all maps
- Re-baked lightmaps across all maps for improved lighting accuracy

- Added a new aiming feature allowing players to switch between auto-aim and manual aim temporarily using the left mouse button or the right joystick on gamepads. When Autoaim is enabled, hold the left mouse button or move the right joystick on a gamepad to switch to manual aim; release the button to return to auto-aim. 
This feature is only active if auto-aim is enabled in the settings. You can also toggle auto-aim on or off 
during gameplay using the V o LB buttons.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470738/6b8075ac5ebde6dd8a09bef99fa4d114323ff986.png

- Improved the design of the Game Menu

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470738/c64beb1e36eb9fccfebe4e351b9677179990d67e.png

- Added descriptions for different skill types in the Skill Codex menu for better player understanding
- Added cooldown information to the Active cards. (Known issue: Some cards may display cooldowns as 0 or slightly incorrect value; this will be addressed in a future update)
- Updated the "Fuller" Boon text from "When your HP is full, all attacks increase by 20%" to "When your HP is full, all damage you deal increases by 20%"

- Heroes will no longer collect healthpacks when their HP is already full.

- Fixed an issue where the "One More Life" upgrade from meta-progression was not displaying the skill UI on the HUD at the start of the game. (Known issue: Skill number displays as 0 in the pause menu if it's an upgrade; this will be addressed in a future update)
- Fixed an issue where the Monthly Leaderboard was not saving high scores or resetting correctly
- Fixed a controller issue in the Skill Codex menu
- Corrected typos on several cards
- Fixed some localized text
- Several smaller fixes and improvements

A few known bugs will be fixed soon.

Have a good game!

notes.title: Devlog - Future Updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been a while since our last game update. The main reasons are that the game was not commercially successful, and I had to work on another game project to make a living. I am still developing the game as a solo developer.

We have 2 partially finished updates for a new character and an endless mode. There will also be map and UI improvements, game balancing, and more. I plan to finish these updates before the end of the year.

Please contact us via our social media channels or email if you have any questions or comments.

Thank you all for your patience and support.


 Twitter: https://twitter.com/OverrunSurvivor
 Email: contact@midquestgames.com
 Website: https://www.midquestgames.com/ 


Some screenshots(WIP) from upcoming updates:

See you next time!

notes.title: Update v.0.8.1: New Character
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

We apologize for the delay in the game update. We have added a new Enemy HP system and difficulty settings feature, which took a bit longer than expected. We understand how frustrating this can be for our players who are eagerly waiting for new updates. Thank you for your patience and understanding.


We have added some new features to the game:

 New Character: Shadow Whisperer has a unique Elemental Synergy ability. The first selected Elemental boost card alters all weapon and skill powers of the Shadow Whisperer to the selected elemental type. This feature is unique to the new character. The character comes with 5 unique skills and a pet companion.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470738/61b7414629d0164a027921e72c53b4e1bd3b9d82.png

 Difficulty Settings: There are 4 difficulty settings for experienced players. Upgrades are recommended for Hard and Extreme modes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470738/be63a1bc4e56db43e81358b11005d06a135d073f.png
 Challenges: There are 4 challenges to playing the game with some limitations. Upgrades are recommended.
 Skill Codex: You can now access all skill card information via the Skill Codex Page.
 8 new achievements
 3 new Dash Upgrades: Extra Dash, Dash Length, Dash Attack


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470738/2650d9dc224690faa4f7cc0f1e15d5b2f3d0d88b.png

Due to these changes, some weapon and skill damage values have changed. There may be some balance issues with the new settings.

Please let us know if you encounter any problems or new bugs.
You can always reach us via our Discord channel (provided below), feedback form, or email: contact@midquestgames.com.

We will fix these problems with hotfixes during the week.

These features will bring added challenges to your gaming experience, and we hope that you will enjoy them.

The next updates will include Endless Mode, a new Character, additional skills, and a new Boss for Frostfall. We will try not to make you wait so long again.

If you are enjoying the game, please consider posting a review.

Thank you!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43470738/e68964cf505af09e8550928cee5fcb2c7279fc7b.png

notes.title: Scheduled Update
notes.content:
We're sorry for the delay in the updates. 

We've received some messages from our players expressing their concerns about the update, and we understand how eagerly you've been waiting for it. We wanted to make sure that everything was perfect, so we took some extra time to test our new HP and difficulty system.

The new update will be released on May 8th. You'll be able to enjoy a new character and new skills, along with the difficulty system and challenges. 

We're fully committed to updating the game every week and adding new features throughout this month.

Thank you so much for your continued support and for playing our game!



Midquest Games
